title: Molecular dynamics study of the impact of glycosylation on conformational properties of trimeric N-terminal domain of human copper transporter 1.
authors: Samsonov, Sergey A; Fraczyk, Tomasz; Ufnalska, Iwona; Bal, Wojciech
one_liner_zh: 该文用微秒级分子动力学模拟研究糖基化对无序铜转运蛋白hCtr1 N端三聚体构象的影响，对象为IDR且用物理模拟方法，但未涉及PPI或结合机制，故综合评分为6。
abstract: In this study, we investigate how N- and O-glycosylation affect the structure and dynamics of the disordered N-terminal extracellular domain of human copper transporter 1 (hCtr1), a trimeric transmembrane protein responsible for cellular copper uptake. Copper is an essential trace element, with both deficiency and excess linked to severe disorders. In mammals, its homeostasis is tightly regulated by proteins involved in copper transport and storage. The N-terminal region of hCtr1, comprising 65 amino acids, contains specific copper-binding motifs critical for its function but remains structurally uncharacterized due to its intrinsically disordered nature. This domain can be N- and O-glycosylated at Asn15 and Thr27, respectively, with the latter potentially influencing its physiological function. However, the structural consequences of these modifications remain unclear. We built a trimeric model of the hCtr1 N-terminal domain and performed microsecond-scale molecular dynamics simulations for both glycosylated and non-glycosylated forms. The resulting conformational ensembles revealed unimodal distributions across structural and dynamical descriptors, consistent with disordered behaviour and showing no significant impact of glycosylation. These findings enhance our understanding of the structural flexibility of hCtr1 and provide a foundation for future studies into its structure, function and regulation.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了N-和O-糖基化如何影响人铜转运蛋白1（hCtr1）无序N端胞外域的结构和动态，该蛋白是一种负责细胞铜摄取的三聚体跨膜蛋白。铜是必需的微量元素，其缺乏和过量均与严重疾病相关。在哺乳动物中，铜的稳态由参与铜转运和储存的蛋白质严格调控。hCtr1的N端区域包含65个氨基酸，含有对其功能至关重要的特异性铜结合基序，但由于其内在无序特性，该区域在结构上尚未被表征。该结构域可在Asn15和Thr27位点分别进行N-和O-糖基化，其中后者可能影响其生理功能。然而，这些修饰的结构后果仍不清楚。我们构建了hCtr1 N端结构域的三聚体模型，并对糖基化和非糖基化形式进行了微秒级分子动力学模拟。所得构象集合在结构和动态描述符上显示出单峰分布，与无序行为一致，且未显示糖基化的显著影响。这些发现增进了我们对hCtr1结构灵活性的理解，并为其结构、功能和调控的未来研究奠定了基础。
